name: Deep Operator Network
summary: An operator-learning architecture using branch and trunk neural networks for function-to-function prediction.
core_idea: Encode input-function observations with a branch network and combine them with output-coordinate features from a trunk network.
innovation: Learns nonlinear operators across varying input functions rather than training a separate solution network per instance.
